description: From the fz-kdt.152 refutation (2026-09-02): exact_direct_callable_layout's agreement is full CallableDescr equality and its REFUSING half (disagreement -> fallback) is correct by construction -- but has zero test and zero corpus witness: the refuter loosened agreement to function-identity-only and ALL 875 fixtures stayed byte-identical in canon and behavior.
